title: Production auth: Cognito callback URLs and Google OAuth for apricity.anth.us
description: Set Cognito callback and logout URLs to https://apricity.anth.us (and localhost for dev); add the Google OAuth authorized redirect (Cognito domain /oauth2/idpresponse) and JavaScript origin for the production client; set Amplify secrets GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and ALLOWED_EMAILS for the production branch. Verify: an allowed email signs in end to end; a non-allowed email is rejected by the pre-sign-up trigger. Guide: /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus/docs/google-oauth-setup.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Env var APRICITY_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS set on app d2n7w4kwqyfwn4 = https://apricity.anth.us/,http://localhost:5173/,http://127.0.0.1:5181/. STILL NEEDED (user must set; agents may not enter credentials): branch secrets GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, ALLOWED_EMAILS for app d2n7w4kwqyfwn4 branch main (Amplify console: Hosting > Secret management, or SSM /amplify/d2n7w4kwqyfwn4/main/<NAME>). Google client needs authorized redirect https://<cognito-domain>/oauth2/idpresponse after the first successful backend deploy, plus JS origin https://apricity.anth.us.
